reviews.t: Incredible purchase! I love this contour stick!
reviews.x: This contour and highlighting stick changed the makeup process for me! It has such a lightweight creamy, blendable formula and made applying my shape so much easier! I will be repurchasing this! I have used it on three different foundations; I was impressed that it worked terrific with ALL of them. It just blended right in, giving a beautiful natural finish. The shade I picked was perfect for my skin tone, and the description does an excellent job of helping you figure out which shade is suitabl

Okay, I normally just throw on some mascara, tinted moisturizer and a little blush and run out. I spend about 3 minutes doing everyone. Now, I have never even tried to contour and this really made me feel comfortable taking that step. It blended fairly easily. I would repurchase this item
Definitely worth the price. This is so easy to apply and has a good amount of pigment. This contour stick is also easy to blend into the skin .
Love easy makeup options. I use the highlight side under my eyebrows, eyes, and cheeks and contour on my nose and forehead and jaw line! Love it!

reviews.t: Not a fan of the color or consistency
reviews.x: The contour was a little too orange for my liking. The consistency of both wasn’t great but worse for the highlighter. I also thought the highlighter would be similar to concealer in color but it was sparkly highlighter so keep that in mind.
I’m still learning how to do my own makeup but this was definitely something I will buy again, it gives my nose the perfect shape lol

I’m really new to the idea of contouring, like way late to the party. I thought I’d try it out because this stick offers a very convenient 2-in-one option of a darker color and a highlight.  I like the consistency of the product, and this didn’t  irritate my skin. I’m not entirely convinced that the darker color isn’t too dark/orange for me. I don’t really get any sun, so I don’t have any tanned tones in my skin. I do like the highlighter color, but it’s either exactly my pale skin color or supe

I gave it a crappy review because it kind of sucked for me.  I have very fair skin and I went with the W02 medium, which is probably my own fault for picking that color.  But the brown is so light it almost looks orange.  It really is that light.  It was my first time trying a cream contour which maybe my own inexperience, but I didn't like the feel of it.  It felt like a Crayola crayon on my face.  The stuff was very hard to blend and the colors didn't work well together either.  I really regre

I like cream contour sticks. I normally use the Fenty Skinstick but I'm always looking for a more affordable option.  This stick was nice. It applies easily, is creamy and has a decent pigment. I had no problem blending it. Overall I think it's a good product.   For me personally, I don't think the highlight shade was the most flattering on my medium olive skin tone. It was a little too light and had glitter. The glitter was ok, but I'd like a highlight to use all over the face without glitter.

The highlighter is so pretty, and I have the light the contour is dark enough to blend without it disappearing. The colors go on smoothly with great pigment, I used a brush but it doesn’t blend nicely. I don’t own a beauty blender but I feel like that would be what to use with this. It could work nicely but it’s not my favorite type of contour. I gave 4 stars where it matters, pigment, application, packaging, and one star off for the blending, but at the same time it’s not for me.

reviews.t: Doesn't work all that well. Smells AWFUL
reviews.x: To start with, this stuff smells TERRIBLE!  Smells like a cheap box of crayons.  It feels really heavy on your skin, which I don't like.  It made me break out after one wear (I have sensitive skin, so I was hesitant to wear this, but had to test it).  In the "light" stick, the highlight definitely has a bit of sparkle, and the contour is very orange-y. All in all, I will definitely not be wearing or purchasing again.

Love this stick is super pretty, the colors are really pigmented and the bronzer is super natural, I’m not giving this 5 stars because even though the highlighter is pigmented, is not sparkly it’s just plain white, overall I think it’s a nice product and could make a good gift.

This is such a bad quality product. The shades shown in the pictures are a lot darker than in real life. The contour doesn't work and the product is too thick and doesn't blend, unless you drench your face with water. The highlighter is garbage and doesn't work either. This is one of the worst bronzers and highlighters I've ever used.

It was an ok contouring stick. The dark side was a little difficult to blend and the light side had like glimmer shine in it. I would have preferred if it didnt have the sparkles. It did the job though and looked ok.

Honestly I’m pretty impressed with this contour stick. I was iffy a out ordering a brand I’m not familiar with but needed a cool toned contour color that didn’t break the bank. Goes on and blends really well.

This highlight and contour stick is awesome! I have light/medium skin tone and it compliments it perfectly. The product is creamy and pigmented. I love that it’s a 2-in-1 so it perfect to take traveling!
I use this everyday and the pigment and texture is great my only problem is it gives me blackheads and makes me break out, also it doesn't last it seems to wear off half way through the day
I love this product but the caps break and won’t stay on. Hard to keep in your makeup bag with the caps always coming off.
This contour stick is the worst it’s like clay. It’s completely un-blendable. It sits on top of the skin, it’s horrible.
[[VIDEOID:4056f5b664dfd08b69f1922fd09955c3]] Best for lighter skin, easy to blend with good cream consistency.
If you want BRONZER then this is a decent product. It blends fairly well, but it is not a cool tone contour

reviews.t: Smells weird and doesn't go on. . .
reviews.x: Don't buy this, smells weird and cheap. Plus it wouldn't go on my skin easily when applying.
Easy to use and blends pretty well. However, I have not used the highlighter part yet.
Nice contour / highlighter.  Blended well.  Nice price point. Def recommend
Hard. Does not blend well.  Color not as described

claims.text: Many reviewers find the stick easy to apply and blend, with a creamy, lightweight formula.
Several reviewers praise the pigmentation and value, calling it a good affordable option.
Some reviewers say the contour shade looks too orange or too light rather than the expected tone.
A few reviewers dislike the highlighter, noting it is sparkly or plain white rather than concealer-like.
Some reviewers report blending difficulties or a thick, heavy consistency.
